ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: A conversation session between the user and Jarvis AI.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

title.description: Short display title of the chat session.

lastMessage.description: Preview of the most recent message in the session.

messageCount.description: Total messages recorded in this session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when session was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when session was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message within a Jarvis chat session.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message owner.

hasImage.description: Whether this message included an analyzed image.

languageCode.description: Language code active for this message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

JarvisNote.title: JarvisNote
JarvisNote.description: A user-created note synced to Firestore.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when note was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when note was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

JarvisReminder.title: JarvisReminder
JarvisReminder.description: A user reminder with optional scheduled timestamp.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reminder owner.

dueAtMillis.description: Scheduled epoch time in milliseconds (0 if unscheduled).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when reminder was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when reminder was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

JarvisSettings.title: JarvisSettings
JarvisSettings.description: User preferences for Jarvis language and voice synthesis.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the settings owner.

autoSpeak.description: Automatically speak AI replies via TextToSpeech.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}/mes.description: User-scoped chat messages inside a session.
